provenance.aggregation: monthly mean daily precipitation RATE (not a monthly total)
provenance.grid_footprint: MERRA-2 cell ~0.5 x 0.625 degrees containing the point

quality.policy: incomplete current month excluded; invalid readings not used; <= 3% interior missing months, gaps <= 2 months filled causally; otherwise refused

structural_break.note: A shift between the two halves of the record: climate change, a change in the POWER/MERRA-2 inputs, or both; it is not diagnosed further here.

ets_ana.formula: WAPE = 100 * sum|forecast - actual| / sum|actual| (robust to near-zero individual months)

clim_trend.formula: WAPE = 100 * sum|forecast - actual| / sum|actual| (robust to near-zero individual months)

config.bootstrap: moving-block over forecast origins, 2000 resamples, seed 7
config.selection: lowest mean MAE on development origins only
